about_short_description.short_description: Apten is an AI-powered automated SMS tool for local businesses.

product.name: Apten AI SMS & Voice Agents
product.description: AI-powered automated agents that engage leads via SMS, voice calls, and email to qualify, nurture, and convert leads for local businesses and enterprises.

product.name: Apten CRM Integrations
product.description: Native and API-driven integrations that sync lead data, conversation context, and tags between Apten AI agents and CRM systems like Salesforce.

product.name: Apten Intelligent Automation Features
product.description: Automation tools including smart notifications, dynamic dialing, local presence dialing, automatic tagging, and real-time alerts to optimize lead engagement and follow-up.

product.name: Apten Omnichannel AI Platform
product.description: A platform that enables AI agents to switch seamlessly between SMS, voice, and email channels to engage leads based on their preferences and responses.
